# Results (generated by bench/make_results_md.py)

Gold set: 14 PRs, 46 scored requirements. **Labels are not human-reviewed** and were written by Claude.
Faults: all hunks a requirement points at are removed; controls share no hunks with the fault.

| variant | done precision | done recall | abstained | faults no longer 'done' | 95% CI | faults -> 'missing' | false alarms | judge errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ours-only (trained models) | 0.868 | 0.943 | 6 | 3/32 | 0.03-0.24 | 0/32 | 1/26 | n/a |
| hybrid: our top-5 hunks + LLM judge + our verifier | 0.966 | 0.824 | 5 | 21/28 | 0.57-0.87 | 15/28 | 1/19 | 0 |
| hybrid ablation: judge sees all hunks (no retrieval) | 0.963 | 0.839 | 9 | 20/26 | 0.58-0.89 | 16/26 | 2/18 | n/a |
| hybrid ablation: no verifier | 0.97 | 0.821 | 0 | 19/31 | 0.44-0.76 | 15/31 | 1/26 | n/a |

Caveats: faults are injected only where the baseline said 'done', so denominators differ per row;
gold base rate of 'done' is 39/46, so precision must be read against 0.85; judge calls were mostly Groq gpt-oss-120b.
